decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already records the separate power and signal connectors, their complete pinouts, the 5V route, its return, and the 5V_EN route.
The source decision assigns 5V and 5V_EN routes but does not change the I2C pull-ups, bus speed, cable length, or existing SDA0/SCL0 routing.
The source decision does not change native USB behavior or the existing D+/D- interboard route, which is already recorded by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
J_PWR_POWER is an interboard power connector; its pinout does not alter the separate J_BAT battery connector specification.
The interboard 5V and enable routing does not change the battery NTC terminal, connector, function, or thermal-protection controller.
The source connector pinout does not change battery overcharge, overdischarge, or electrical-protection behavior.
The source message does not change the SK6812 charge-status display method, GPIO assignment, or dedicated-LED policy.
The source specifies electrical connector partitioning and pinouts but does not necessarily change connector orientation, placement, accessibility, spacing, or mounting-hole clearance.
The 5V interboard route does not explicitly change the selected LED family, its data GPIO, or its power and logic requirements.
The connector pinout decision does not necessarily alter the board dimensions, aspect ratio, installation orientation, USB-C placement, or mounting-hole constraints.
